name: GainSnap
summary: Peak and RMS level matching for your DAW
description: GainSnap measures the selected Peak or RMS level while Match is enabled, adjusts gain toward the target, and holds that gain when Match is disabled. Choose Peak or RMS from the output readouts, enter a target below the meter, and use the adjacent Match and rematch icons. The vertical meter shows output Peak and RMS in separate colors, with a target line and gain marker.
features: Live peak matching with a protected fade-in
Compact output meter and pulsing Match controls
